name: Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens
description: Nora Lin leans on her family as she navigates life and young adulthood in outer borough-NYC.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Nora takes her first steps toward financial independence in an attempt to move out of her dad's house.

videos.title: Atlantic City
videos.overview: Nora and Grandma go to Atlantic City, where Nora gambles and runs into an old acquaintance on the boardwalk, and Grandma and her friends battle to use a casino power outlet.

videos.title: Savage Valley
videos.overview: Nora takes a job at a real estate office and becomes a hyper-competent assistant with a little help from Adderall, alienating her online gaming friends in the process.

videos.title: Paperwork
videos.overview: Nora has difficulties cashing a check at her bank. She later joins focus groups to make some extra money.

videos.title: Not Today
videos.overview: Nora impulsively dyes her hair after a fight with her dad, and Wally goes to a single-parent support group meeting.

videos.title: Vagarina
videos.overview: After Nora suffers a vaginal injury, she’s tapped by a DJ to record her chronic queefing for his new track.

videos.title: Grandma Loves Nora
videos.overview: Nora competes with Edmund for their grandmother's affection, and Wally creates an Instagram account to impress his crush.

videos.title: Grandma & Chill
videos.overview: Grandma tells Nora the story of how she met her husband in the style of a Korean drama.

videos.title: Launch Party
videos.overview: Edmund and Nora prepare to launch their app, and Wally’s dinner date goes terribly awry.

videos.title: China
videos.overview: After Scrubr gets acquired by a company overseas, Nora moves to China. Back in Queens, Grandma befriends an injured pigeon.

videos.title: Never Too Old
videos.overview: After a starry-eyed look at her future, Nora trains a new CBD store employee. Grandma's newly diagnosed perfect bill of health leads to a face-off. Daniel catches Nora by surprise.

videos.title: Stop! Nora Time
videos.overview: After getting an MRI during an earthquake, Nora time travels to the iPod-filled world of 2003, where she sets out to warn her younger self about the mistakes she's going to make.

videos.title: Charlie's Angels
videos.overview: After Nora and Melanie reunite with a high school friend, they realize New York City isn't what it used to be. Grandma braces herself for a visit from her rich cousin Rosalind.

videos.title: Edmund's Back
videos.overview: Despite many setbacks and creepy auditions, Nora stands by Edmund's newfound acting career. Wally panics after discovering that Brenda's online dating profile is still active.

videos.title: Don't F**k with Grandmas
videos.overview: Grandma and her gal pals band together to take down a scammer targeting the elderly.

videos.title: Nora Meets Brenda
videos.overview: Nora fears that her maniacal imaginary friend is taking things too far when he helps her plot revenge against Wally’s sweet-natured girlfriend Brenda during a weekend trip to the country.

videos.title: Tales From the Blackout
videos.overview: Wally, Doug and Nora swap stories of childhood embarrassment, sexual mishaps and bad drug experiences as they ride out a power outage, and Nora learns something new about her mom.

videos.title: Shadow Acting
videos.overview: Nora inadvertently becomes an actor, Wally has a revelation after catching up with old friends, and Edmund decides to pursue his dreams.

videos.title: The Simple Life
videos.overview: Edmund embraces life in Los Angeles, Grandma teaches Brenda about Chinese cuisine and traditions, and Nora does some soul searching when her car breaks down in New Mexico.

videos.title: Home
videos.overview: Nora embraces her new life in New Mexico, but a distressing letter from home makes her reevaluate the future, and Grandma deals with loneliness during coronavirus lockdowns.

videos.title: Nightmares
videos.overview: Nora tries therapy after having weird dreams, Grandma goes to Brooklyn for a distant cousin’s funeral, Wally’s proposal to Brenda doesn’t go as planned, and Edmund enjoys his newfound fame.

videos.title: Too Hot to Survive
videos.overview: Nora signs up for a survival reality show to get rich quick and prove Wally wrong, and Wally uses his extra time at home to micromanage Grandma's life.

videos.title: Love & Order
videos.overview: Nora grows insecure as Edmund relishes in his success as a series regular on "Love & Order," Wally tries to land a new IT job, and Edmund discovers something new about his ancestry.

videos.title: þetta reddast
videos.overview: While accompanying Edmund on a trip to Iceland to track down his long-lost relatives, Nora meets a wise elfin woman.

videos.title: Bad Grandma
videos.overview: Nora is alarmed when Grandma transforms into a ruthless drug kingpin, Edmund and the gym bros surprise Wally with a bachelor party, and Brenda discovers her fiancé's big secret.

videos.title: Carfished
videos.overview: Grandma pushes Wally to make a grand romantic gesture to win back Brenda, and Nora gets a mystical glimpse of what her life could have been.

videos.title: Nora Is Awkwafina from Queens
videos.overview: Nora gains a new perspective on life after meeting Awkwafina, Wally and Brenda make amends, and Edmund unexpectedly finds love.
